entries.name: Sougato Bose
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Sougato (Co-Director) investigates experimental protocols to test the quantum nature of gravity, in close collaboration with experimentalists cooling and levitating large masses.

entries.name: Jonathan Oppenheim
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Jonathan Oppenheim (Co-Director) explores an alternative to quantum gravity in which spacetime remains classical while quantum theory is modified, resulting in an intrinsic breakdown of predictability

entries.name: Peter Barker
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Peter Barker (Head of Experimental Research) cools, manipulates and transports atoms, molecules and nanoparticles in optical tweezers, and explores levitated nanomechanics for quantum sensing.

entries.name: Marika Taylor
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Marika Taylor (Executive Dean) works on quantum gravity, string theory and holography. She uses the holographic principle to explore black holes and quantum information.

entries.name: Christian Boehmer
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Christian Böehmer (Mathematics) studies general relativity and cosmology, focusing on alternative gravity theories that avoid singularities.

entries.name: Betti Hartmann
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Betti Hartmann (Mathematics) researches general relativity and field theory, focusing on black holes, solitons, and applications to astrophysics and cosmology.

entries.name: Rosemary Harris
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Rosemary Harris (Mathematics) studies stochastic non‑equilibrium processes, including interacting particle systems and large deviations.

entries.name: Rod Halburd
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Rod Halburd (Mathematics) works on integrable systems, the anti‑self‑dual Yang‑Mills equations, general relativity and complex analysis.

entries.name: Toby Cubitt
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Toby Cubitt (Physics & Astronomy) is interested in mathematically rigorous toy models of AdS/CFT duality and its connections to quantum error correction and Hamiltonian simulation.

entries.name: Lluis Masanes
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Lluis Masanes (Physics & Astronomy) is interested in discrete holography and quantum causality.

entries.name: Marzena Szymanska
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Marzena Szymanska (Physics & Astronomy) studies out-of-equilibrium phenomena in light–matter systems, including exciton-polaritons, cavity and circuit QED, and cold atoms.

entries.name: Andrew Green
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Andrew Green (Physics & Astronomy) researches correlated quantum systems, including tensor network models in AdS/CFT and both equilibrium and out-of-equilibrium strongly correlated phenomena.

entries.name: Clara Bradley
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Clara Bradley (Philosophy) is a lecturer whose research focuses on the philosophy of physics, particularly the structure of gauge theories and their Hamiltonian and Lagrangian formulations.

entries.name: Tania Monteiro
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Tania Monteiro (Physics & Astronomy) works at the interface of quantum and classical regimes and collaborates closely with experimentalists.

entries.name: Johannes Noller
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Johannes Noller (Physics & Astronomy) studies gravitational wave science, cosmology and particle physics, combining theoretical and data-driven methods and exploring dark energy.

entries.name: Alessio Serafini
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Alessio Serafini (Physics & Astronomy) specialises in quantum information with continuous variables, quantum optics and quantum control, including Gaussian states and quantum protocols.

entries.name: Ofer Lahav
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Ofer Lahav (Physics & Astronomy) is the Perren Chair of Astronomy, whose research focuses on observational cosmology, galaxy surveys and the nature of dark energy and dark matter.

entries.name: Emma Tobin
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Emma Tobin (Science & Technology Studies) is Professor of Philosophy of Science, working on the metaphysics of natural kinds and the philosophy of chemistry and biochemistry.

entries.name: Rory Jubber
entries.title: Center Affiliate · Quantum Information Science
entries.research: Rory Jubber (Science & Technology Studies) is a lecturer in the philosophy of science. His research focuses on the metaphysics of physical science and the social epistemology of science.

entries.research: Prostory funkcí, symetrisace, prostory s normou invariantní vůči nerostoucímu přerovnání, Orliczovy prostory, Lorentzovy prostory, vnoření, kompaktní vnoření, optimalita, logaritmické Sobolevovy nerovnosti na prostorech s pravděpodobnostní mírou, analýza nekonečně mnoha proměnných v pravděpodobnostním prostoru, věty o stopách, regularita řešení diferenciálních rovnic, optimální partnerské páry prostorů funkcí, teorie interpolací, teorie aproximací, omezenost a kompaktnost operátorů, míra nekompaktnosti, supremální oparátory, integrální operátory, diskretisace, váhové nerovnosti, elementární témata z analýzy, základní nerovnosti a odhady, rekreační matematika, historie matematiky, popularisace matematiky, překlady knih.

entries.name: Dušan Pokorný
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Reálná analýza (konvexní funkce, zobecnění konvexity), fraktální geometrie (fraktální křivosti), integrální geometrie (křivosti pro singulární množiny), další náhodná témata (Tukeyova hloubka, stochastické procesy)

entries.name: Milan Pokorný
entries.title: Professor · Profesor
entries.research: Matematická analýza parciálních diferenciálních rovnic, zejména rovnic matematické mechaniky a termodynamiky tekutin. Existence řešení, regularita, kvalitativní vlastnosti řešení.

entries.name: Dalibor Pražák
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Parciální diferenciální rovnice (existence a regularita řešení, chování pro velké časy, odhady dimenze atraktorů). Další zájmy: dynamické systémy, teorie her, nestandardní analýza.

entries.name: Vít Průša
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Termodynamika kontinua, fenomenologický popis nelineární odezvy komplexních materiálů, nenewtonovské tekutiny, stabilita proudění.

entries.name: Pavel Příhoda
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Teorie okruhů.

entries.name: Pavel Pyrih
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Teorie kontinuí, konstrukce prostorů s danými vlastnostmi, lokální vlastnosti kontinuí, homogenita kontinuí.

entries.name: Jan Rataj
entries.title: Professor · Profesor
entries.research: (Geometrická) teorie míry, konvexní geometrie, integrální geometrie (zejména míry křivosti množin se singularitami a jejich integrálně-geometrické vztahy), stochastická geometrie.

entries.name: Jaroslav Richter
entries.title: Professional Services Staff · THP
entries.research: Uživatelská podpora

entries.name: Martin Rmoutil

entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent

entries.name: Tomáš Roubíček
entries.title: Academic Research Staff · Vědecký pracovník
entries.research: Aplikovaná matematická analýza, parciální diferenciální rovnice, matematické modelováni v mechanice a fyzice spojitých prostředí a materiálové vědě a inženýrství, termodynamika, teorie optimalizace, a numerická analýza.

entries.name: Subham Roy
entries.title: Academic Research Staff · Vědecký pracovník
entries.research: Mahlerova míra, modulární formy, eliptické křivky, univerzální formy, aritmetika funkčního tělesa.

entries.name: Pavel Růžička
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Teorie svazů, teorie modulů.

entries.name: Sebastian Schwarzacher-Softić
entries.title: Academic Research Staff · Vědecký pracovník
entries.research: Nelineární parciální diferenciální rovnice (existence, jednoznačnost, regularita, numerická analýza). Dynamika tekutin (struktura, interakce, ne-Newtonovaká tekutina). Variační počet (nestandardní růst, elastická tělesa). Numerické výpočty pro PDR (časová schémata, řád konvergence, Galerkinovy metody). Analýza evolučních nelineárních PDR (proměnné oblasti, vnitřní geometrie, systémy s proměnlivým kontaktem).

entries.name: Antonín Slavík
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Matematická analýza (zejména diferenciální rovnice a teorie integrálu), historie matematiky, kombinatorika, rekreační matematika, programování ve Wolfram Mathematica.

entries.name: Lenka Slavíková
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Banachovy prostory funkcí, prostory Sobolevova typu, lineární a multilineární multiplikátory, singulární integrální operátory, maximální funkce, váhové nerovnosti

entries.name: Petr Somberg
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Diferenciální a algebraická geometrie, Lieovy grupy a algebry (klasické, afinní, super) a jejich representační teorie, Homogenní prostory (vlajkové variety, (lokální) symetrické prostory, reduktivní prostory), Homogenní vektorové bundly a jejich ekvivariantní homomorfismy, Konečné reflexní grupy a jejich geometrie, Homotopie a (ko)homologické teorie (ekvivariantní spektra), Kvantové grupy a nekomutativní geometrie (kvantové homogenní prostory.)

entries.name: Vladimír Souček
entries.title: Professor · Profesor
entries.research: Invariantní diferenciální operátory na varietách s danou geometrickou strukturou. Zobecněné Cartanovy geometrie, a speciálně parabolické geometrie. Cliffordova analýza v jedné a ve víc proměnných. Aplikace teorie reprezentací v analýze. Exaktní komplexy invariantních diferenciálních operátorů.

entries.name: Ondřej Souček
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Matematické modelování a numerické výpočty v pozemské a planetární geofyzice (slapově buzená deformace, disipace a transportní procesy v nitrech ledových měsíců Europa a Enceladus, numerické modelování evoluce pevninských ledovců na Zemi a na Marsu); Termodynamika a mechanika kontinua (konstitutivní teorie komplexních materiálů, termodynamika a mechanika kontinua na površích, terdmodynamické modelování okrajových podmínek); Teorie směsí (heterogenní katalýza, proudění pórézním prostředím, částečné tavení a transport taveniny)

entries.name: Jiří Spurný
entries.title: Professor · Profesor

entries.name: David Stanovský

entries.name: Jan Šaroch
entries.title: Associate Professor · Docent
entries.research: Množinové aspekty teorie modulů.

entries.name: Zbyněk Šír

entries.title: Assistant Professor · Odborný asistent
entries.research: Zabývám se chováním složitých materiálů, jak tekutin, tak pevných látek, které disipují energii. entries.name: Christoph Allolio
entries.title: Assistant professor
entries.research: Membrane biophysics, curvature elasticity, applied differential geometry, continuum electrostatics, interfacial phenomena, molecular simulations, multiscale simulations, stochastic processes, electronic structure.

entries.name: Miroslav Bulíček
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Partial differential equations - existence, regularity and stability theory; continuum thermodynamics; mathematical analysis and modelling of flows and deformation of materials with complicated rheology

entries.name: Zdeňka Crkalová
entries.title: Staff, secretary
entries.research: Executive and technical editor of the journal Commentationes Mathematicae Universitatis Carolinae.

entries.name: Roman Holovko
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Symplectic and contact topology, low-dimensional topology, dynamical systems.

entries.name: Jaroslav Hron
entries.title: Researcher
entries.research: Numerical solution of flow problems in biomechanics, finite element method, parallel solvers for large sparse systems software for high performance computing.

entries.name: Branislav Jurčo
entries.title: Professor
entries.research: Mathematical physics, homological and homotopical methods in string theory and quantum field theory, higher algebraic and geometric stuctures and their applications in physics, BV quantization of gauge theories, generalized geometry

entries.name: Lukáš Krump
entries.title: Lecturer
entries.research: Invariant operators in the context of differential geometry and Clifford analysis. Classical and modern projective and non-euclidean geometry.

entries.name: Svatopluk Krýsl
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Theory of sympletic Dirac operators. Hodge theory for elliptic complexes on Hilbert fibre bundles over compact manifolds. Application of Lie groups representation theory in differential geometry.

entries.name: Roman Lávička
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Mathematical analysis, hypercomplex analysis. Applications of representation theory of Lie groups and superalgebras. Constructions of Gelfand-Tsetlin bases for polynomial solutions of invariant differential equations.

entries.name: Josef Málek
entries.title: Professor
entries.research: Analysis of nonlinear partial differential equations, in particular those describing mechanical, thermal and chemical processes in fluids, solids and mixtures. Thermodynamics and mechanics of non-Newtonian fluids.

entries.name: Michal Pavelka
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: I have two main scientific interests: Geometric non-equilibrium thermodynamics and theoretical electrochemistry. In the former I typically combine Hamiltonian mechanics with gradient dynamics (GENERIC framework). In the latter I make simulations of hydrogen fuel cells and redox flow batteries. Both are covered by the courses I am teaching.

entries.name: Réamonn Peadar Ó Buachalla
entries.title: Assistant professor
entries.research: My research focuses on the noncommutative geometry of quantum groups and their quantum homogeneous spaces, and in particular quantum flag manifolds. The approach used involves a mixture of Hopf algebras, monoidal categories, Lie theory, complex and Kähler geometry, C*-algebras, and unbounded operator theory.

entries.name: Dušan Pokorný
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Real analysis (convex functions, generalized convexity), fractal geometry (fractal curvatures), integral geometry (curvatures for singular sets), other random topics (Tukey depth, stochastic processes)

entries.name: Milan Pokorný
entries.title: Professor
entries.research: Mathematical analysis of partial differential equations, particularly equations of mathematical fluid mechanics and thermodynamics. Existence of a solution, regularity, qualitative properties of solutions.

entries.name: Vít Průša
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Continuum thermodynamics, phenomenological description of non-linear response of complex materials, non-Newtonian fluids, stability theory.

entries.name: Jan Rataj
entries.title: Professor
entries.research: (Geometric) measure theory, convex geometry, integral geometry (in particular, curvature measures of sets with singularities and their integral-geometric relations), stochastic geometry.

entries.name: Jaroslav Richter
entries.title: Staff, secretary
entries.research: User support

entries.name: Tomáš Roubíček
entries.title: Researcher
entries.research: Applied mathematical analysis, partial differential equations, mathematical modelling in continuum mechanics and physics and in materials science and engineering, thermodynamics, optimization theory, and numerical analysis.

entries.name: Petr Somberg
entries.title: Associate professor
entries.research: Differential and algebraic geometry, Lie groups and algebras (classical, affine, super) and their representation theory, Homogeneous spaces (flag manifolds, (locally) symmetric spaces, reductive spaces), Homogeneous vector bundles and their equivariant homomorphisms, Finite reflection groups and their geometry, Homotopy and (co)homology theories (equivariant spectra), Quantum groups and non-commutative geometry (quantum homogeneous spaces.)

entries.name: Vladimír Souček
entries.title: Professor
entries.research: Invariant differential operators on manifolds with a fixed geometric structure. Generalized Cartan geometries, in particular, parabolic geometries. Clifford analysis in one or several variables. Applications of representation theory in analysis. Exact complexes of invariant differential operators.

entries.name: Robie Hennigar
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: I study fundamental aspects of gravity and its interplay with quantum physics. My work covers the dynamics of black hole horizons, holographic descriptions of quantum black holes, and the fate of black hole interiors beyond general relativity.

entries.name: Paul Heslop
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate

entries.title: Research Group Affiliate

entries.name: Nabil Iqbal

entries.name: Ayan Kumar Patra

entries.name: Madalena Lemos
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: Studying conformal and superconformal field theories, including local and extended operators (defects), through non-perturbative approaches such as bootstrap techniques and chiral algebras (vertex operator algebras) of superconformal field theories.

entries.name: Paul McFadden

entries.name: Silvia Nagy
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate

entries.name: Mendel Nguyen

entries.name: Simon Ross
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: I work on string theory and quantum gravity, focusing on the emergence of spacetime in holography and the description of black holes, using the gravitational path integral and entanglement.

entries.name: Tom Rudelius
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: Tom Rudelius's research explores the intersection of string theory, cosmology, and quantum field theory, focussing on how theoretical constraints from quantum gravity shape models of the early universe and particle physics.

entries.name: Parita Shah
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: My research explores integrability and dualities in string theory, with emphasis on T-dualities and integrable sigma models, studying their holographic duals, and higher-derivative corrections to supergravity.

entries.name: Tahani Maturi

entries.name: Cuong Nguyen

entries.name: Emmanuel Ogundimu
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate

entries.name: Rachel Oughton
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: Rachel’s main area of research is causal inference in controlled and observational studies, particularly in the social sciences. She is also interested in quantification of uncertainty in computer models, and is involved in several outreach projects.

entries.name: Ian Vernon
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: Ian develops and applies Bayesian approaches to Uncertainty Quantification for the analysis of complex physical systems. Application areas include cosmology, epidemiology, nuclear physics, geology and systems biology.

entries.name: Darren Wilkinson
entries.title: Research Group Affiliate
entries.research: Darren uses computational Bayesian inference to study stochastic dynamical systems and other complex models. He works on substantive applications in fields such as systems biology and engineering.

nust-27-groups.scope: 从六张官方专题表逐条交叉卡片的详细研究主题，24 名成员；涵盖 SNS、SEECS、SINES、NICE、S3H。院系名册确定现任职位，研究组表确证专长。

entries.name: Nadima El-Hassan
entries.title: Visiting Scholar
entries.research: Nadima joined the School of Finance and Economics as a full-time staff member in July 1997. Her research interests include the pricing and hedging of complex derivatives, term structure modeling, risk management and portfolio attribution analysis. She has publications in a number of the leading international journals in finance including The Journal of Financial Engineering, Asian Capital Markets, Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control and Journal of Computational Finance.

entries.name: Len Patrick Garces
entries.title: Visiting Scholar
entries.research: Len Patrick Garces is an applied mathematician whose research interests lie within the field of financial and actuarial mathematics, primarily on the applications of probability theory and stochastic analysis to tackle financial and actuarial problems (e.g. financial or insurance risk modelling and management, asset price modelling, term structure modelling, pricing and hedging financial derivatives) and the development of numerical and statistical methods to solve these problems.

entries.name: Hajra Khan
entries.title: Graduate Research Student
entries.research: My research focuses on developing advanced interfacial engineering strategies to improve the performance, stability, and lifespan of rechargeable aqueous zinc-ion batteries (ZIBs). Although zinc-ion batteries are promising candidates for next-generation energy storage due to their inherent safety, cost-effectiveness, abundance, and environmental advantages, their practical application is hindered by challenges associated with zinc metal anodes. These include non-uniform zinc deposition, dendrite formation, hydrogen evolution, corrosion, and undesirable side reactions, which can compromise battery performance and cycling stability.

entries.name: Dongfang Li
entries.title: Graduate Research Student
entries.research: Dongfang Li is a PhD candidate in chemistry at the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences at the University of Technology Sydney. His research focuses on advanced energy storage and conversion technologies, particularly CO₂ electroreduction and water-splitting electrolysis, with an emphasis on integrating Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) and their derivatives as functional materials. He has developed specialized expertise in synchrotron-based characterization techniques, including in-situ X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and Powder Diffraction (PD), as well as Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FT-IR) and complementary in-situ/operando characterization methods.

entries.name: Chao Liu
entries.title: Research Assistant
entries.research: Dr. Chao Liu is a Postdoctoral Research Associate under the supervision of Prof. Guoxiu Wang in the Centre for Clean Energy Technology, University of Technology Sydney. His research interests include the synthesis of two-dimensional functional membrane materials for ion transport and energy conversion applications.

entries.name: Dayanne Mozaner Bordin
entries.title: Lecturer In Analytical Chemistry
entries.research: Dayanne Bordin is an analytical chemist and a member of the Atomic Medicine Initiative (AMI). Her research focuses on developing innovative mass spectrometry-based techniques for characterising small biomolecules, trace elements, proteomic bioindicators, and emerging nanomaterials in a forensic, biological, and clinical context.

entries.name: Connor Phillips
entries.title: Graduate Research Student
entries.research: Connor Phillips is an Associate Lecturer in the Faculty of Science at UTS. His teaching interests are primarily in the field of molecular biosciences including Molecular Biology and Metabolic Biochemistry. His research focuses on the analysis of non-protein amino acids that have been implicated in the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative disorders such as multiple sclerosis using analytical chemistry techniques including LC-MS

entries.name: Alam Shabbir
entries.title: Graduate Research Student
entries.research: Mr Alam Shabbir is an Emerging Research Fellow of the Australian National Health and Medical Research Council (NHMRC EL1) and a Presidential Research Fellow (PRF) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS), with expertise in organic synthesis, analytical chemistry, spectroscopic characterisations, and biomedical engineering. Currently, Mr Alam leads the research focusing on developing hybrid materials with desired functions, optical and nanophotonic properties, and integrating these new functionalities into molecular/nano-probes and functional devices for ultrasensitive bioassay, biomedical imaging, and precise therapy.

entries.name: S Nibedita Swain
entries.title: Graduate Research Student
entries.research: S Nibedita Swain is a full-time PhD candidate, funded by Sydney Quantum Academy, and currently a visiting scholar with Centre for Quantum Computation and Communication Technology, School of Mathematics and Physics, University of Queensland. Her research focuses on quantum computation and quantum error correction using optical systems. Specifically, in the direction of photonic architecture based on continuous variable systems ranging from quantum communication to quantum computation.
